Hanzo Templates let developers, teams, and enterprises launch battle-tested open-source stacks onto sovereign local and distributed clouds in seconds.

## Overview

Every template in the Hanzo Marketplace is an open-source blueprint containing:
- Production-ready infrastructure specifications (services, persistent volumes, environment variables)
- Integrated observability, telemetry, and logging
- Pre-configured networking, SSL/TLS termination, and edge routing
- Valid Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) and dependency provenance

## Deploying a Template

You can deploy templates from the web console, via the Hanzo CLI, or through the `/v1/templates` API.

### Via CLI

```bash
# Run any verified template locally or on your sovereign cluster
hanzo run redis
hanzo run postgres
hanzo run n8n
```

### Via Console

Browse the catalog at [console.hanzo.ai/store](https://console.hanzo.ai/store), select your project, configure environment variables, and click **Deploy**.

## Open Source Partner Program

Maintainers of verified templates earn ongoing revenue share through our [Template Kickbacks Program](/docs/templates/kickbacks):
- **25% Total Revenue Share**: 15% base usage kickback + 10% active maintenance bonus.
- **Sovereign Payouts**: Settled automatically on-chain in HUSD, crypto wallets, or Stripe Connect.
- **Managed Escrow Pool**: 25% of cloud spend is automatically set aside into an immutable escrow pool until claimed.
